mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers concerns about labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0% in the late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production demand) indicate robust demand growth, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST show rising trends simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained increase in FEDFUNDS rates raises discount rates, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in UNRATE below 4.0% signals labor market strength, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive when UNRATE crosses below 4.0% in the strengthening labor market.

mechanism_narrative: Rising supply (INDPRO) alongside falling monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) in an easing cycle creates valuation pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS falls in the easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening cycle, a sustained rise in UNRATE above 5.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5.0% in the tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) over 3 months signals robust production growth, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not positive when INDPRO shows a sustained upward trend in the expanding economy.
